title: Alchemist: Parametric Control of Material Properties with Diffusion Models
authors: Prafull Sharma, Varun Jampani, Yuanzhen Li, Xuhui Jia, Dmitry Lagun, Fredo Durand, Bill Freeman, Mark Matthews
excerpt: A shiny surface remains on the teapot after a roughness edit.
summary: 论文通过额外训练与参数控制编辑材料；仍展示粗糙度修改不充分和形状缺失的失败，生成结果不等同传统渲染器。
supports: 直接反证“专业材质描述足以保证物理正确”，但不是本次普通文本改写的失败实验。
